### Deviations

1. Overlay category URLs carry the store origin from `fixtures/store/meta.json`
   (`https://optimalx.com.sa/<slug>/c<id>`), not the plan's literal
   `http://localhost:3210/...`: the engine's click interceptor only client-routes
   an anchor whose origin equals `store.url`, so a localhost href would be a
   full page load into the `?storeId=` trap and every overlay link from the
   home, header or `/categories` would render the home. Same convention as the
   fixture's product URLs.
2. A third overlay file, `membership.json` (id to product ids), beside the two
   the plan names, so the server never re-derives membership from the taxonomy.
3. `app/routes.ts` gained one line; a route file is not discovered without it.
4. Five `ox.tax.index.*` keys, not two (see step 6).
5. `docs/build/offline-preview.md` gained a section (documentation of the switch).
6. `listing/faq.ts` gained the taxonomy fallback (utility FAQ + FAQPage node).
7. Step 5(b) not rebuilt: it was at HEAD (ff725a5); a test now pins it.
